[[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] '''Ta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who served in the [[Mantellian Army|Mantellian army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Ta, along with [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Dregg (Human)|Dregg]] and Ensign [[Peters]], was stationed on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during a [[Separatist War|civil war]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. She was stationed in the [[Avilatan Badlands]], where the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] planted unexploded mortar shells. She and Peters were ordered by Dregg to devise a life-or-death game of chance in the region. They were forced to challenge refugees in the area to run the mines and gather three unexploded shells.<ref name="TOR" />
